programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Having just finished the Statue of Liberty, Gustave Eiffel is at the peak of his career. Everything changes the day he crosses paths with his love and their forbidden relationship inspires him to change the Paris skyline forever.

programme.title: Sometimes Always Never
programme.desc: Scrabble-obsessed Merseyside tailor Alan's eldest son Michael stormed out of the house after a particularly heated round of the popular board game, never to return. Years later, Alan and his other son Peter continue the search while trying to repair their own strained relationship.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Wings of Desire
programme.desc: Follows the plight of an angel who becomes captivated by a beautiful trapeze artist and decides to trade his gentle existence for the torturous emotions of human life.

programme.title: Moving
programme.desc: Renko, a girl in the sixth grade, is at first unperturbed by her parents' decision to separate. With the companionship of her boyfriend, Minoru, and Sally, a classmate in the same boat, Renko gradually realises the practical implications of divorce, and tries repeatedly to get her parents to reconcile. An old man teaches her about the need to forget the past.

programme.title: Metropolis
programme.desc: Fritz Lang's sci-fi masterpiece tells of a futuristic city divided by class, and continues to influence cinema today. Superbly remastered, this 2008 version restores the film to the original director's cut, with 25 minutes of extra scenes.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha

Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

An old man teaches her about the need to forget the past.

programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. programme.title: The Cook Up with Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S9 E8 Food For Friends Grab your friendship bracelets, because tonight, Adam, cookbook author Steph De Sousa and Sean Skeels and Marley Whatarau are making food for friends.

programme.title: The Cook and the Chef
programme.desc: S3 E25 Root Veg and Guinea Fowl After the exhilaration of the New Zealand trip, this show opens with Maggie back on home soil - and almost knee-deep in it too. She's trekking through mud with vegetable grower Dominic Scarfo in search of a vegetable that is often overlooked and undervalued: the swede.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: S5 E6 Best of Nordic Cookery (1) Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the series. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E5 Olives: The Elixir of Life Puglia is one of the biggest producers of olive oil. At home, Sophie serves up a chocolate mousse with olive oil - a dish new to her Puglian neighbours.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Spain
programme.desc: S1 E1 Galicia Rick's journey begins in Galicia - famous for pilgrims, rain, fog, fresh seafood, empanadas and more rain. He eats 'tortillas de patata' in the King of Spain's favourite restaurant and meets up with a couple of cool dudes who run a little restaurant in the old market of Santiago de Compostela.

programme.title: Strait to the Plate
programme.desc: S2 E2 Masig We meet Aunty Mary and Aunty Flora who cook up two reef fish: the baked boxfish and unicorn fish curry. Surprisingly, Aaron has never tried either of these fish before.

programme.title: Sara's Istanbul Delights
programme.desc: S1 E2 Purple Sara listens to the meaning of the colour purple, that is identified with Istanbul in history for the city from Saffet Emre Tonguc and she tastes Turkish coffee in the Grand Bazaar.

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: S6 E9 Townsville Just off Townsville is the famous Magnetic Island which is Hayden's destination, but first he heads out to meet a young sweet potato farmer, and pick up some pineapples. Then it's over to Maggie for a sea kayak tour before it's time to cook.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: S7 E7 Trattoria Favourites Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and Lidia prepares three recipes. A quick ziti with kale pesto and bacon, fusilli with roasted tomato pesto, and campanelle with shrimp and fennel.

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia
programme.desc: E8 Tempura Tempura, Japan's most famous fried dish is a delicate work of art. When cooked to perfection, it is unlike anything else in scent and taste.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: S1 E2 Paula will be cooking on the terrace-serving up locally-caught langoustines on a potato and smoked dulse wafer with pickled carrot. She will be making what she describes as 'love on a plate-a country pie made with locally bred ham served up with crowdie cheese and pickled smoked beetroot salad.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programme.desc: S2 E32 Italian Flag Pasta Rachael is celebrating the Italian flag by bringing us three different pastas in all three of its colors. She's breaking down the steps to make a delicious cacio e pepe with copious amounts of cheese, a pesto pasta with toasted Sicilian pistachios and pignoli nuts, and finally for red, an all aglione pasta.

programme.title: Masters of Taste with Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: S2 E8 Kolkata - Marwari Food Gary Mehigan gets a taste of opulence from a Marwari kitchen; what will Gary cook for a host of women who love their food?

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet with Justine Schofield
programme.desc: S4 E27 Justine shows you her lunchbox bites, surf and turf salad and a delicious green smoothie. Adam Swanson also drops in to make his cannelloni filled with chicken, pancetta and sage.

programme.title: The Cook Up with Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S9 E8 Food For Friends Grab your friendship bracelets, because tonight, Adam, cookbook author Steph De Sousa and Sean Skeels and Marley Whatarau are making food for friends.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: S3 E2 A celebration of the Italian Sunday tradition, where Nonna's table brings together family, tradition, and irresistible flavours from slow-cooked sugo to crispy festive sweets.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: S1 E4 Bakewell Pudding Adam's made it to the stunning Peak District to discover the accidental invention of the famous Bakewell Pudding. He also visits a destination gastropub for his first taste of local grouse, and his tastebuds get unexpectedly transported to West Africa at a Cameroonian kitchen in the heart of the Derbyshire countryside.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Spain
programme.desc: S1 E2 Basque One of the great delights of Basque food are 'pinxos'; huge tapas portions. In this two-part episode, Rick learns all about them in a crowded bar in San Sebastian. In Ordizia, he marvels at how the toddlers from local schools all come to the market to see the various wares on display, while the teacher explains what things are.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: S6 E1 Lacko & Kinnekulle: A Historical Food Adventure Tareq Taylor, one of Sweden's most loved chefs, visits Nordic countries to collect the very best culinary experiences.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E6 Tales from the Orchard Sophie helps with the cherry harvest and uses them in a favourite pastry.

programme.title: Strait to the Plate
programme.desc: S2 E3 Thursday Island Aaron arrives in the Kaywalagal region, home of the Kaurareg people and the administrative hub of the Torres Strait region, Thursday Island.

programme.title: Sara's Istanbul Delights
programme.desc: S1 E3 Orange Sara experiences Istanbul's street tastes with food blogger Tuba Satana and cooks pide with pumpkin.

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: S7 E8 Great Grains Lidia shares some Italian comfort foods - beef and potato goulash, country salad, and a luscious hazelnut parfait to end on a sweet note.

programme.desc: S9 E9 Eggspress Yourself Stand out chef Bee Satongun and stand-up comedian Bron Lewis are in the kitchen. Adam's request? That they eggspress themselves.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Having just finished the Statue of Liberty, Gustave Eiffel is at the peak of his career. Everything changes the day he crosses paths with his love and their forbidden relationship inspires him to change the Paris skyline forever.

programme.title: Sometimes Always Never
programme.desc: Scrabble-obsessed Merseyside tailor Alan's eldest son Michael stormed out of the house after a particularly heated round of the popular board game, never to return. Years later, Alan and his other son Peter continue the search while trying to repair their own strained relationship.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Wings of Desire
programme.desc: Follows the plight of an angel who becomes captivated by a beautiful trapeze artist and decides to trade his gentle existence for the torturous emotions of human life.

programme.title: Moving
programme.desc: Renko, a girl in the sixth grade, is at first unperturbed by her parents' decision to separate. With the companionship of her boyfriend, Minoru, and Sally, a classmate in the same boat, Renko gradually realises the practical implications of divorce, and tries repeatedly to get her parents to reconcile. An old man teaches her about the need to forget the past.

programme.title: Metropolis
programme.desc: Fritz Lang's sci-fi masterpiece tells of a futuristic city divided by class, and continues to influence cinema today. Superbly remastered, this 2008 version restores the film to the original director's cut, with 25 minutes of extra scenes.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.desc: E8 Margaret and David review Vice Versa, Wings of Desire and Less Than Zero, with Wim Wenders discussing his Cannes winning Wings of Desire in an interview from the 1987 festival.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E11 Mel Gibson Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: S3 E2 A celebration of the Italian Sunday tradition, where Nonna's table brings together family, tradition, and irresistible flavours from slow-cooked sugo to crispy festive sweets.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: S1 E4 Bakewell Pudding Adam's made it to the stunning Peak District to discover the accidental invention of the famous Bakewell Pudding. He also visits a destination gastropub for his first taste of local grouse, and his tastebuds get unexpectedly transported to West Africa at a Cameroonian kitchen in the heart of the Derbyshire countryside.

programme.title: This Tastes Funny
programme.desc: S1 E4 Iliza and Noah navigate the South Island's wild West Coast. From heli touring among pristine glaciers, to meeting the less than pristine local bar patrons, who call this region home.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: S1 E19 Glasgow A Today's brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Glasgow where it's a family affair, as each restaurant is represented by a child and parent pairing! First up are Saffron By Paradise.

programme.title: The Cook Up with Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S9 E8 Food For Friends Grab your friendship bracelets, because tonight, Adam, cookbook author Steph De Sousa and Sean Skeels and Marley Whatarau are making food for friends.

programme.title: The Cook and the Chef
programme.desc: S3 E25 Root Veg and Guinea Fowl After the exhilaration of the New Zealand trip, this show opens with Maggie back on home soil - and almost knee-deep in it too. She's trekking through mud with vegetable grower Dominic Scarfo in search of a vegetable that is often overlooked and undervalued: the swede.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: S5 E6 Best of Nordic Cookery (1) Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the series. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E5 Olives: The Elixir of Life Puglia is one of the biggest producers of olive oil. At home, Sophie serves up a chocolate mousse with olive oil - a dish new to her Puglian neighbours.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Spain
programme.desc: S1 E1 Galicia Rick's journey begins in Galicia - famous for pilgrims, rain, fog, fresh seafood, empanadas and more rain. He eats 'tortillas de patata' in the King of Spain's favourite restaurant and meets up with a couple of cool dudes who run a little restaurant in the old market of Santiago de Compostela.

programme.title: Strait to the Plate
programme.desc: S2 E2 Masig We meet Aunty Mary and Aunty Flora who cook up two reef fish: the baked boxfish and unicorn fish curry. Surprisingly, Aaron has never tried either of these fish before.

programme.title: Sara's Istanbul Delights
programme.desc: S1 E2 Purple Sara listens to the meaning of the colour purple, that is identified with Istanbul in history for the city from Saffet Emre Tonguc and she tastes Turkish coffee in the Grand Bazaar.

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: S6 E9 Townsville Just off Townsville is the famous Magnetic Island which is Hayden's destination, but first he heads out to meet a young sweet potato farmer, and pick up some pineapples. Then it's over to Maggie for a sea kayak tour before it's time to cook.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: S7 E7 Trattoria Favourites Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and Lidia prepares three recipes. A quick ziti with kale pesto and bacon, fusilli with roasted tomato pesto, and campanelle with shrimp and fennel.

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia
programme.desc: E8 Tempura Tempura, Japan's most famous fried dish is a delicate work of art. When cooked to perfection, it is unlike anything else in scent and taste.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: S1 E2 Paula will be cooking on the terrace-serving up locally-caught langoustines on a potato and smoked dulse wafer with pickled carrot. She will be making what she describes as 'love on a plate-a country pie made with locally bred ham served up with crowdie cheese and pickled smoked beetroot salad.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programme.desc: S2 E32 Italian Flag Pasta Rachael is celebrating the Italian flag by bringing us three different pastas in all three of its colors. She's breaking down the steps to make a delicious cacio e pepe with copious amounts of cheese, a pesto pasta with toasted Sicilian pistachios and pignoli nuts, and finally for red, an all aglione pasta.

programme.title: Masters of Taste with Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: S2 E8 Kolkata - Marwari Food Gary Mehigan gets a taste of opulence from a Marwari kitchen; what will Gary cook for a host of women who love their food?

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet with Justine Schofield

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Having just finished the Statue of Liberty, Gustave Eiffel is at the peak of his career. Everything changes the day he crosses paths with his love and their forbidden relationship inspires him to change the Paris skyline forever.

programme.title: Sometimes Always Never
programme.desc: Scrabble-obsessed Merseyside tailor Alan's eldest son Michael stormed out of the house after a particularly heated round of the popular board game, never to return. Years later, Alan and his other son Peter continue the search while trying to repair their own strained relationship.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Wings of Desire
programme.desc: Follows the plight of an angel who becomes captivated by a beautiful trapeze artist and decides to trade his gentle existence for the torturous emotions of human life.

programme.title: Moving
programme.desc: Renko, a girl in the sixth grade, is at first unperturbed by her parents' decision to separate. With the companionship of her boyfriend, Minoru, and Sally, a classmate in the same boat, Renko gradually realises the practical implications of divorce, and tries repeatedly to get her parents to reconcile. An old man teaches her about the need to forget the past.

programme.title: Metropolis
programme.desc: Fritz Lang's sci-fi masterpiece tells of a futuristic city divided by class, and continues to influence cinema today. Superbly remastered, this 2008 version restores the film to the original director's cut, with 25 minutes of extra scenes.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E5 Movie Show 1988 Ep 5 An episode featuring Christian Bale discussing his role in Empire of the Sun and Wendy Hughes reflecting on portraying a prostitute in Warm Nights on a Slow Moving Train.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E6 Movie Show 1988 Ep 6 Margaret and David review Slamdance, Couch Trip, Overboard, Repentance and doco Cannibal Tours, with film news, festival highlights and the premiere of Pandemonium.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S2 E13 Episode 13 This vast island continent is home to some of the hardest places to reach on Earth. But for the mega trucks that keep the country moving, getting there is just another day at the office. Longer than a jet liner and heavier than a tank, they can run 24/7, pulling anything from houses to hamburgers. Behind the wheel are some of the best and toughest drivers in the world, their motto: anything, anytime, anywhere. Steve Graham fights torrid weather conditions as he tries to create a road train, while Yogi's truck breaks down on a cross-country journey.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E4 New Cold Blood For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. In Townsville, Queensland, long-distance trucker Peter gets ready for a cross-country haul in which he has to move a mixed freight through bush, farmland and desert to Darwin.

programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E2 Rodney Reed On the morning of April 23rd, 1996, 19-year-old Stacey Stites' body was found half-naked by the side of the road. DNA found on Stites, matched Rodney Reed, a local man who had been a suspect in several other sexual assault cases. Reed was arrested and sentenced to death for Stites' murder. Although the cops had their DNA match, Stacey's then fiance police officer Jimmy Fennell emerged as an alternate suspect. A decade after the crime, Fennell was sent to prison for sexually assaulting a person in his custody and has been accused of abusive behaviour towards Stites. New forensic evidence casts doubt on the original timeline of the crime and shows that Stites' death may have occurred while she was at home alone with her fiance.

programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E3 Sabrina Butler In 1989, Sabrina Butler, a 17-year old woman, arrived at a Columbus Mississippi hospital with her baby, Walter Jr, who was pronounced dead on arrival. The nurses and doctors noticed various marks on the child's body and became suspicious of foul play. The police were called and Sabrina couldn't give a straight description of what happened to her baby. Eventually, she signed a confession that she had punched her child out of frustration. The autopsy report confirmed that a blow to the stomach had killed the baby. Sabrina was charged with capital murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. Several years later, British-born attorney and death penalty case expert Clive Stafford Smith took on Sabrina's case. Clive uncovered a corrupt system in Mississippi in which medical examiners would manipulate autopsies and scientific evidence to buttress the claims of law enforcement and prosecution. In Sabrina's case, specious medical analysis and overzealous law enforcement and prosecutors led to her conviction.

programme.desc: S6 E7 Episode 7 In today's episode paramedics try to help an 81-year-old woman with dementia - but must earn her trust before she will let them in, an 89-year-old has fallen and has pain in her leg and a Polish man suffering from agonising abdominal pain needs his daughter's help to talk to paramedics. In the cab crewmates chat about accents, fear of sharks, whales and dolphins, and tell terrible jokes. Crewmates Naomi Whatley and Kyle Matty are called to treat 81-year-old Joyce who has dementia and diabetes. But Joyce is refusing to let the district nurse or her carer in to help her, so it's up to Naomi and Kyle to win her over. Meanwhile paramedics Hannah Meredith and Aaron Campbell are sent to 45-year-old Michal who is experiencing acute stomach pain. Michal and his wife don't speak much English, so their daughter Sara acts as translator. To complicate things, Michal has a history of medical problems including diabetes, high blood pressure and a slipped disc.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E3 Trail Blazers For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E1 Episode 1 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. Turbo's on a mission as he takes the biggest gamble of his career. Steve Grahame battles 2000 km of dirt, damage and dramas at the wheel of a monster load. Glen Waters faces disaster. In Townsville, Queensland, long-distance trucker Peter gets ready for a cross-country haul in which he has to move a mixed freight through bush, farmland and desert to Darwin.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E2 Episode 2 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. In this episode, Matt Adams gets himself into trouble as he transports a bull, while the Kendalls share an experience as a family.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E6 Break On Through For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.desc: S1 E3 Jamie Oliver Mary is joined by her kindred spirit, the globally renowned chef Jamie Oliver. Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. Because of the more than hasty take-off, one of the visitors is left behind. The little alien finds himself all alone on a very strange planet. Fortunately, the extra-terrestrial soon finds a friend and emotional companion in 10-year-old Elliot, who discovered him looking for food in his family's garden shed. While E.T. slowly gets acquainted with Elliot's brother Michael, his sister Gertie as well as with Earth customs, members of the task force work day and night to track down the whereabouts of Earth's first visitor from Outer Space.

Now a hardworking life insurance salesman and a caring family man, the former police officer, Michael MacCauley, has taken the commuter rail to New York for the past ten years. But, unexpectedly, things will take a turn for the worse, when on one of his daily journeys, the cryptic passenger, Joanna, makes Michael a generous and tempting offer to locate a single commuter or face grave consequences. Is this a sick joke, or is this indeed a serious situation? As Michael races against the clock to solve this wicked conundrum, everyone aboard is a suspect, in a deal where there's definitely more than meets the eye. Can he decide in time who's the one?

A wanted man on the run, Will must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family who is trapped inside the building above the fire line.

Rickman, Grant and Greg Wise co-star as the well-intentioned suitors who are trapped by the strict rules of society and the conflicting laws of desire.

Arriving at her new college, she finds herself not right for any clique but somehow is muscled into one that she never would have picked on her own: alongside mean girls, sweet girls and weird girls whose only thing in common is how good they sound when they sing together, in the out-loud comedy Pitch Perfect. When Beca takes this acoustic singing group out of their world of traditional arrangements and perfect harmonies into all-new mash-ups, they fight to climb their way to the top of the cutthroat world of college a cappella. This could wind up either the coolest thing they'll ever do or the most insane, and it will probably be a little of both.

With one chance left at redeeming their legacy, they must they must face off against the toughest competition on the planet: German supergroup Das Sound Machine and fight for their right to win at the World Championships of A Cappella. It will take the power of sisterhood to find their voice and see what it takes to be the world's top pitches!

Fuelled by rage and armed with heavy machinery, Nels sets out to dismantle the cartel one man at a time, but his understanding of murder comes mainly from what he read in a crime novel. As the bodies pile up, his actions ignite a turf war between Viking and his long-standing rival White Bull, a soulful Native-American mafia boss, that will quickly escalate and turn the small town's bright white slopes blood-red.

The people of Earth are desperate to escape the planet's crime and poverty, and they critically need the state-of-the-art medical care available on Elysium - but some in Elysium will stop at nothing to enforce anti-immigration laws and preserve their citizens' luxurious lifestyle. The only man with the chance bring equality to these worlds is Max, an ordinary guy in desperate need to get to Elysium. With his life hanging in the balance, he reluctantly takes on a dangerous mission - one that pits him against Elysium's Secretary Delacourt and her hard-line forces - but if he succeeds, he could save not only his own life, but millions of people on Earth as well.

programme.desc: Based on a true story, veteran deep-sea divers brave brutal ocean conditions to save a trapped crew-mate stranded hundreds of feet beneath the surface.

programme.desc: Marvin, a Milwaukee real estate agent, gets a crimson envelope from a former partner-in-crime. Thrust into a world of hitmen and betrayal, he must face his dark past and a vengeful crime lord brother.

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: The untold origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, better known as sworn enemies, but who once were friends bonded like brothers.

programme.title: Watchmen: Chapter I
programme.desc: In an alternate world, the murder of a government sponsored superhero draws his outlawed colleagues out of retirement, into a mystery that threatens their lives and the world itself.

programme.title: Watchmen: Chapter II
programme.desc: Former heroes face threats. The Comedian is dead, Dr. Manhattan exiled to Mars, Ozymandias survived an attack and Rorschach is arrested.

programme.title: Brian Walsh: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: A tribute to Brian Walsh's imprint on Australian media; reshaping TV and sport, mentoring talent, and championing a more modern, diverse culture.

programme.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programme.desc: Nobody is ready for the mayhem and surprises that ensue when six of the worst youngsters disrupt the town's yearly Christmas performance.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: In Oz, two clashing witches, Elphaba and Glinda, form an unlikely friendship. Elphaba, wrongly labeled wicked, seeks to expose the corrupt Wizard ruling the land.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Loretta Sage's novels are filled with ancient tombs and daring adventures, but that doesn't mean she's prepared for them in real life. When she is kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire to locate a legendary lost city, Loretta's handsome cover model, Alan, sets off on a heroic but hapless rescue mission. Thrust into an epic thrill-ride through the jungle, the unlikely pair must work together to survive the elements, and survive each other, to find the city's fabled treasure before it's lost forever.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: An epic tale, set in the Rocky Mountains of Montana in the early 1900s, of three brothers and their father living in the remote wilderness and how their lives are affected by love, betrayal and brotherhood. After being discharged, Colonel Ludlow decides to raise his three sons in the wilds of Montana, where they can grow up away from the government and society he has learned to despise. As the brothers set out to fight a war in Europe, suspicion and jealousy threatens to tear apart their once indestructible bond when Susanna enters their lives.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: As war rages in Europe, a Nazi-scalping squad of American soldiers, known to their enemy as The Basterds, is on a daring mission to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Beca is that girl who'd rather listen to what's coming out of her headphones than what's coming out of you. Arriving at her new college, she finds herself not right for any clique but somehow is muscled into one that she never would have picked on her own: alongside mean girls, sweet girls and weird girls whose only thing in common is how good they sound when they sing together, in the out-loud comedy Pitch Perfect. When Beca takes this acoustic singing group out of their world of traditional arrangements and perfect harmonies into all-new mash-ups, they fight to climb their way to the top of the cutthroat world of college a cappella. This could wind up either the coolest thing they'll ever do or the most insane, and it will probably be a little of both.

programme.title: Easy A
programme.desc: After a little white lie about losing her virginity gets out, a clean-cut high school girl sees her life paralleling Hester Prynne's in 'The Scarlet Letter', which she is currently studying in school - until she decides to use the rumour mill to advance her social and financial standing.

programme.title: Here Today
programme.desc: Veteran comedy writer Charlie Burnz forms an unlikely yet hilarious and touching friendship with New York lounge singer Emma Payge. Emma unexpectedly wins a lunch with the comedy legend, and their friendship gets off to an extremely rocky start (think seafood allergy, a hospital visit, and an epi pen). Before long, each finds in the other a sort of soul mate, forging a deep bond that kicks the generation gap aside and redefines the meaning of friendship, love, and trust.

programme.title: Fun Mom Dinner
programme.desc: Four mums, whose only common ground is their kids' preschool class, get together for a dinner. The night begins as a disaster, but they have more in common than they thought.

programme.title: Rough Night
programme.desc: Five best friends from college reunite 10 years later for a wild bachelorette weekend in Miami. Their partying takes a dark turn when they accidentally kill a male stripper.

programme.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
programme.desc: A delightful comedy about finding love in the most unexpected places. Two successful New Yorkers, Paul and Meryl, are at their wits' end with repairing their strained marriage. But when they become the only witnesses to a brutal murder, the police hide them away in Wyoming, together. Now these die-hard city dwellers will have to survive the weather, bears, fresh air, and forced time with one another if they want to make it out alive.

programme.title: A League of Their Own
programme.desc: The story of an all-American girls' professional baseball league formed in 1943 when the men were away at war.

programme.title: Suddenly 30
programme.desc: A hilarious flash-forward romance about a pre-teen girl who goes from geek to glamorous. With the help of some magic wishing dust, 13-year-old Jenna Rink becomes 30 and gorgeous overnight, with everything she ever wanted, except for her best friend Matt. Now, this grown woman must create some magic of her own to help the little girl inside find the true love she left behind.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honour. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she'll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you'll go for someone you love.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her
programme.desc: Two Hollywood divas' surgery-enhanced rivalry goes beyond the grave.

programme.title: Identity Thief
programme.desc: Unlimited funds have allowed Diana to live it up on the outskirts of Orlando. There's only one glitch: she's financing her shopping sprees with an ID stolen from Sandy Patterson, an accounts rep who lives halfway across the US. With only one week to hunt down the con artist before his world implodes, the real Sandy Patterson is forced to extreme measures to clear his name.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: When 93-year-old Thelma Post gets duped by a phone scammer pretending to be her grandson, she sets out on a treacherous quest across the city to reclaim what was taken from her.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: In this send-up of today's most popular horror movies, a familiar-looking group of teenagers find themselves being stalked by a more-than-vaguely recognisable masked killer. As the victims begin to pile up and the laughs pile on, none of your favourite scary movies escape the razor-sharp satire of this outrageously funny parody.

programme.title: Knocked Up
programme.desc: Allison Scott is an up-and-coming entertainment journalist whose 24-year-old life is on the fast track. But it gets seriously derailed when a drunken one-night stand with slacker Ben Stone results in an unexpected pregnancy. Faced with the prospect of going it alone or getting to know the baby's father, Allison decides to give the lovable layabout a chance. An overgrown kid with no desire to settle down, Ben learns he has a big decision to make with his kid's mother-to-be: will he run or stay?

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Beca, Fat Amy and the Barden Bellas are back to pitch slap the world! After a scandal threatens to derail their last year at Barden, the three-time defending champs worry that they've lost their harmony for good. With one chance left at redeeming their legacy, they must they must face off against the toughest competition on the planet: German supergroup Das Sound Machine and fight for their right to win at the World Championships of A Cappella. It will take the power of sisterhood to find their voice and see what it takes to be the world's top pitches!

programme.title: How Do You Know
programme.desc: Lisa is a professional softball player who finds herself adrift when she is suddenly dumped from the team. Confused and looking for direction, Lisa begins a fling with self-centred womaniser Matty, a major league baseball pitcher eager to have his ego stroked.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Henry lives an enviable life in a Hawaiian paradise, spending every night with a beautiful tourist in search of an island fling. It's a sweet life with no strings attached, until he meets Lucy. He and Lucy hit it off from the get-go, but the next day she acts like she doesn't know him. Has his karma come around to kick him in the butt, or what? Actually, Lucy has short-term memory loss, so every night all memory of her day is erased, but a man in love will go to any lengths to win over the girl of his dreams, and if that means having to find imaginative ways of doing it over again every day, then Henry's up for the challenge.

programme.title: Funny Birds
programme.desc: Thrown together under tragic circumstances, three generations of women from the same family are forced to learn to live together on a small rural chicken farm in New Jersey.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: When 93-year-old Thelma Post gets duped by a phone scammer pretending to be her grandson, she sets out on a treacherous quest across the city to reclaim what was taken from her.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and a new range of kick-ass weapons, the Ghostbusters battle to save the city from an uprising of mischievous ghouls.

programme.title: Just Go with It
programme.desc: Danny Maccabee meets the girl of his dreams, but has to enlist his loyal assistant, Katherine, to pretend to be his soon-to-be ex-wife in order to cover up a careless lie.

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: Gwen and Eddie are 'America's Sweethearts' - the country's favourite couple, on-screen and off, but when their very public romance turns into a very private break-up, only veteran press agent Lee and Gwen's assistant, Kiki, can help Gwen and Eddie show some love while they promote their last film together. The press junket is in a resort hotel miles from anywhere, and while Lee and Kiki frantically try to keep the media away from the real story - and keep Gwen and Eddie from revealing their secret - Kiki finds something entirely unexpected.

programme.title: Fun Mom Dinner
programme.desc: Four mums, whose only common ground is their kids' preschool class, get together for a dinner. The night begins as a disaster, but they have more in common than they thought.

programme.title: Knocked Up

An overgrown kid with no desire to settle down, Ben learns he has a big decision to make with his kid's mother-to-be: will he run or stay?

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Jay and Annie are a married couple still very much in love, but ten years and two kids have cooled the passion. To get it back, they decide - why not? - to make a video of themselves trying out every position in The Joy Of Sex in one marathon three-hour session. It seems like a great idea, until they discover that their most private video has gone public. In a panic, they begin a wild night of adventure - tracking down leads, roping in friends, duping Annie's boss - all to reclaim their video, their reputation, their sanity, and, most importantly, their marriage.

programme.title: Along Came Polly
programme.desc: Reuben Feffer is a guy who's spent his entire life playing it safe. Polly Prince is irresistible as a free-spirit who lives for the thrill of the moment. When these two comically mismatched souls collide, Reuben's world is turned upside down, as he makes an uproarious attempt to change his life from middle-of-the-road to totally-out-there.

programme.title: Book Club
programme.desc: Four lifelong friends have their lives forever changed after reading 50 Shades of Grey in their monthly book club.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding
programme.desc: Julianne is almost 28 and still single, but that's OK because on her 28th birthday, Michael is going to propose, thanks to a safety net pact they made in their youth. But when the phone call finally comes, her best friend has found someone else. With Michael unavailable, Julianne realises that she loves him and must stop his wedding!

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the World Championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music, and some questionable decisions, one last time.

programme.title: Flying High
programme.desc: An ex-fighter pilot who is afraid to fly is forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honour. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she'll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you'll go for someone you love.

programme.title: And Mrs
programme.desc: When a reluctant bride-to-be's fiance drops dead, she insists on marrying him anyway, vowing to overcome public opinion, the law of the land, and her loved one's objections.
